title: 日常交往与沟通分寸 · 100 句
description: 协调时间、求助回绝、澄清、借还物品、偏好、分歧、感受、关怀和关系修复。

items.zh: 我中午前有一段空档。
items.en: I have a gap before noon.
answers: I have a gap before noon.

items.zh: 我们把这件事留到下次吧。
items.en: Let's leave this until next time.
answers: Let's leave this until next time.

items.zh: 我现在只能聊五分钟。
items.en: I can only spare five minutes now.
answers: I can only spare five minutes now.

items.zh: 这个时间与我的预约冲突。
items.en: That time clashes with my appointment.
answers: That time clashes with my appointment.

items.zh: 你提前到了，不用在外面等。
items.en: You are early; there is no need to wait outside.
answers: You are early; there is no need to wait outside.

items.zh: 我会尽量把前一件事早点结束。
items.en: I will try to finish the earlier task sooner.
answers: I will try to finish the earlier task sooner.

items.zh: 安排得太满会让我疲惫。
items.en: An overloaded schedule wears me out.
answers: An overloaded schedule wears me out.

items.zh: 我需要一点转换的时间。
items.en: I need a little transition time.
answers: I need a little transition time.

items.zh: 这个约定先不要当成最终安排。
items.en: Please treat this arrangement as provisional.
answers: Please treat this arrangement as provisional.

items.zh: 我可能要比说好的晚一点。
items.en: I may be later than agreed.
answers: I may be later than agreed.

items.zh: 能帮我留个位置吗？
items.en: Could you save me a place?
answers: Could you save me a place?

items.zh: 我能请你顺路带过去吗？
items.en: Could you take it on your way?
answers: Could you take it on your way?

items.zh: 这次恐怕帮不上忙。
items.en: I am afraid I cannot help this time.
answers: I am afraid I cannot help this time.
I am afraid I can't help this time.

items.zh: 我能做前半部分，后半部分不行。
items.en: I can do the first half but not the rest.
answers: I can do the first half but not the rest.

items.zh: 请给我一点考虑的余地。
items.en: Please give me room to think.
answers: Please give me room to think.

items.zh: 我现在不适合接这个任务。
items.en: I cannot take this on right now.
answers: I cannot take this on right now.
I can't take this on right now.

items.zh: 你的帮助已经足够了。
items.en: You have already done enough to help.
answers: You have already done enough to help.

items.zh: 我想自己先试一次。
items.en: I would like to try it myself first.
answers: I would like to try it myself first.

items.zh: 我没有答应这件事。
items.en: I did not agree to this.
answers: I did not agree to this.
I didn't agree to this.

items.zh: 能不能换一种我做得到的方式？
items.en: Could we find a way I can manage?
answers: Could we find a way I can manage?

items.zh: 我听懂了，但还没被说服。
items.en: I understand, but I am not convinced.
answers: I understand, but I am not convinced.

items.zh: 我们说的是同一件事吗？
items.en: Are we talking about the same thing?
answers: Are we talking about the same thing?

items.zh: 这只是你的猜测吗？
items.en: Is that only your assumption?
answers: Is that only your assumption?

items.zh: 我不想误读你的意思。
items.en: I do not want to misinterpret you.
answers: I do not want to misinterpret you.
I don't want to misinterpret you.

items.zh: 你能指出最重要的部分吗？
items.en: Could you highlight the main point?
answers: Could you highlight the main point?

items.zh: 那句话似乎可以有两种解读。
items.en: That sentence seems open to two interpretations.
answers: That sentence seems open to two interpretations.

items.zh: 我知道规则，但不知道理由。
items.en: I know the rule but not the reason.
answers: I know the rule but not the reason.

items.zh: 请先让我确认一件小事。
items.en: Let me verify one small detail first.
answers: Let me verify one small detail first.

items.zh: 我记下的是另一个数字。
items.en: I wrote down a different number.
answers: I wrote down a different number.

items.zh: 我需要的是准确时间，不是大概范围。
items.en: I need an exact time, not a rough window.
answers: I need an exact time, not a rough window.

items.zh: 这个我还在用，稍后给你。
items.en: I am still using this; you can have it later.
answers: I am still using this; you can have it later.

items.zh: 请保持原来的设置。
items.en: Please leave the settings as they are.
answers: Please leave the settings as they are.

items.zh: 还回来之前不用清洗。
items.en: There is no need to wash it before returning it.
answers: There is no need to wash it before returning it.

items.zh: 我想记下你借走了什么。
items.en: I want a record of what you borrowed.
answers: I want a record of what you borrowed.

items.zh: 这件东西需要小心拿。
items.en: This needs careful handling.
answers: This needs careful handling.

items.zh: 我把借来的书放错地方了。
items.en: I have misplaced the borrowed book.
answers: I have misplaced the borrowed book.

items.zh: 它原来就有这道划痕。
items.en: It already had that scratch.
answers: It already had that scratch.

items.zh: 如果找不到，我会及时告诉你。
items.en: If I cannot find it, I will tell you promptly.
answers: If I cannot find it, I will tell you promptly.
If I can't find it, I will tell you promptly.

items.zh: 这不是我自己的，不能转借。
items.en: It is not mine to lend.
answers: It is not mine to lend.
It isn't mine to lend.

items.zh: 我答应今天归还。
items.en: I promised to return it today.
answers: I promised to return it today.

items.zh: 我宁愿选择安静的活动。
items.en: I would rather choose something quiet.
answers: I would rather choose something quiet.

items.zh: 这个对我来说有点过头。
items.en: This is a bit much for me.
answers: This is a bit much for me.

items.zh: 我不在意颜色，更在意舒适。
items.en: Comfort matters more to me than colour.
answers: Comfort matters more to me than colour.

items.zh: 我喜欢有一点自由安排。
items.en: I like having some flexibility.
answers: I like having some flexibility.

items.zh: 我不喜欢被临时催促。
items.en: I dislike being rushed unexpectedly.
answers: I dislike being rushed unexpectedly.

items.zh: 不用为了我改变全部计划。
items.en: You need not change everything for me.
answers: You need not change everything for me.
You needn't change everything for me.

items.zh: 我接受折中，但需要知道条件。
items.en: I can compromise, but I need the terms.
answers: I can compromise, but I need the terms.

items.zh: 我更愿意提前知道。
items.en: I would prefer to know in advance.
answers: I would prefer to know in advance.

items.zh: 这不完全是我的风格。
items.en: It is not quite my style.
answers: It is not quite my style.
It isn't quite my style.

items.zh: 我愿意尝试，只是不熟悉。
items.en: I am willing to try; it is simply unfamiliar.
answers: I am willing to try; it is simply unfamiliar.

items.zh: 我们可能对什么最重要有不同看法。
items.en: We may disagree about what matters most.
answers: We may disagree about what matters most.

items.zh: 我同意结果，但不同意方法。
items.en: I agree with the outcome, not the method.
answers: I agree with the outcome, not the method.

items.zh: 先别把我的话理解为拒绝。
items.en: Please do not take that as a refusal yet.
answers: Please do not take that as a refusal yet.
Please don't take that as a refusal yet.

items.zh: 我想提出一个担心。
items.en: I would like to raise a concern.
answers: I would like to raise a concern.

items.zh: 这件事对我影响比你想的大。
items.en: This affects me more than you realise.
answers: This affects me more than you realise.

items.zh: 我们能否轮流选择活动，免得总按一个人的喜好决定？
items.en: Could we take turns choosing the activity so neither person's preference always wins?
answers: Could we take turns choosing the activity so neither person's preference always wins?
items.notes: take turns doing：轮流做；so 引出公平安排的目的。

items.zh: 我不想争输赢。
items.en: I do not want to turn this into a contest.
answers: I do not want to turn this into a contest.
I don't want to turn this into a contest.

items.zh: 你说得有道理，但还有一个问题。
items.en: Your point makes sense, but one issue remains.
answers: Your point makes sense, but one issue remains.

items.zh: 我们暂时保留不同看法。
items.en: Let's accept that we disagree for now.
answers: Let's accept that we disagree for now.

items.zh: 我会考虑你提出的理由。
items.en: I will consider the reasons you gave.
answers: I will consider the reasons you gave.

items.zh: 我只是累了，不是在不高兴。
items.en: I am tired rather than upset.
answers: I am tired rather than upset.

items.zh: 等消息让我有些坐立不安。
items.en: Waiting for news makes me restless.
answers: Waiting for news makes me restless.

items.zh: 这比我想象的更令人安心。
items.en: This is more reassuring than I expected.
answers: This is more reassuring than I expected.

items.zh: 我需要把思绪整理一下。
items.en: I need to collect my thoughts.
answers: I need to collect my thoughts.

items.zh: 事情终于平静下来了。
items.en: Things have finally settled down.
answers: Things have finally settled down.
items.notes: settle down：平静下来，不一定表示事情结束。

items.zh: 我很庆幸有人注意到了。
items.en: I am relieved someone noticed.
answers: I am relieved someone noticed.

items.zh: 我对这个变化还不习惯。
items.en: I am not used to this change yet.
answers: I am not used to this change yet.

items.zh: 我既期待，也有点紧张。
items.en: I feel both excited and nervous.
answers: I feel both excited and nervous.

items.zh: 我并没有失去兴趣，只是需要休息。
items.en: I have not lost interest; I need a break.
answers: I have not lost interest; I need a break.
I haven't lost interest; I need a break.

items.zh: 这件事一直压在我心上。
items.en: This has been weighing on my mind.
answers: This has been weighing on my mind.

items.zh: 你希望我怎么帮你？
items.en: How would you like me to help?
answers: How would you like me to help?

items.zh: 不方便说也没关系。
items.en: It is fine if you would rather not say.
answers: It is fine if you would rather not say.

items.zh: 我可以陪你等一会儿。
items.en: I can wait with you for a while.
answers: I can wait with you for a while.

items.zh: 你不用现在就表现得很乐观。
items.en: You do not have to sound optimistic now.
answers: You do not have to sound optimistic now.
You don't have to sound optimistic now.

items.zh: 我可能无法完全理解，但愿意听。
items.en: I may not fully understand, but I can listen.
answers: I may not fully understand, but I can listen.

items.zh: 我记得这对你很重要。
items.en: I remember that this matters to you.
answers: I remember that this matters to you.

items.zh: 如果我帮你把事情拆成小步骤，会有帮助吗？
items.en: Would it help if I broke it into smaller steps for you?
answers: Would it help if I broke it into smaller steps for you?
items.notes: would ... if ...：试探性提议；明确提供帮助的人。

items.zh: 你不必为求助道歉。
items.en: You do not need to apologise for asking.
answers: You do not need to apologise for asking.
You don't need to apologise for asking.

items.zh: 我们可以先处理眼前的一步。
items.en: We can focus on the next step first.
answers: We can focus on the next step first.

items.zh: 我不会把这件事告诉别人。
items.en: I will keep this between us.
answers: I will keep this between us.

items.zh: 我刚才的措辞不够妥当。
items.en: My wording was poorly chosen.
answers: My wording was poorly chosen.

items.zh: 我没有意识到会打扰你。
items.en: I did not realise it would disturb you.
answers: I did not realise it would disturb you.
I didn't realise it would disturb you.

items.zh: 是我弄错了日期。
items.en: I was the one who got the date wrong.
answers: I was the one who got the date wrong.

items.zh: 我应该先确认再转告。
items.en: I should have checked before passing it on.
answers: I should have checked before passing it on.

items.zh: 我不想用忙碌作为借口。
items.en: I do not want to use busyness as an excuse.
answers: I do not want to use busyness as an excuse.
I don't want to use busyness as an excuse.

items.zh: 我能做什么来补救？
items.en: What can I do to put this right?
answers: What can I do to put this right?

items.zh: 这次我会按约定跟进。
items.en: This time I will follow through as agreed.
answers: This time I will follow through as agreed.

items.zh: 谢谢你指出问题，而不是默默忍受。
items.en: Thank you for speaking up rather than putting up with it.
answers: Thank you for speaking up rather than putting up with it.

items.zh: 我们需要避免同样的事再发生。
items.en: We need to prevent a recurrence.
answers: We need to prevent a recurrence.

items.zh: 重新建立信任可能需要时间。
items.en: Rebuilding trust may take time.
answers: Rebuilding trust may take time.

items.zh: 我先不占用你的时间了。
items.en: I will let you get back to things.
answers: I will let you get back to things.

items.zh: 剩下的我们改天再谈。
items.en: We can discuss the rest another day.
answers: We can discuss the rest another day.

items.zh: 我会把谈好的内容记下来。
items.en: I will note what we agreed.
answers: I will note what we agreed.

items.zh: 离开之前还有什么需要确认？
items.en: Is there anything to confirm before leaving?
answers: Is there anything to confirm before leaving?

items.zh: 这次谈话帮我理清了思路。
items.en: This conversation helped clarify my thinking.
answers: This conversation helped clarify my thinking.

items.zh: 我需要一点时间消化这些信息。
items.en: I need time to take this in.
answers: I need time to take this in.

items.zh: 我们不用今天决定所有事情。
items.en: We need not decide everything today.
answers: We need not decide everything today.
We needn't decide everything today.

items.zh: 我会在有新消息时联系你。
items.en: I will contact you when there is news.
answers: I will contact you when there is news.

items.zh: 请让我知道后续有什么变化。
items.en: Please keep me informed of developments.
answers: Please keep me informed of developments.

items.zh: 谢谢你愿意坦诚地说。
items.en: Thank you for being frank with me.
answers: Thank you for being frank with me.
